timeline.event: The Lakeshore East timetable includes the 90 Newcastle local, 90A Bowmanville short service, and 90B Union–Oshawa bus.
The original GTFS contains 90, 90A, 90B, 90C and 90D patterns.
Local route 90 was withdrawn after Durham Region Transit introduced overlapping 902A service; Metrolinx explicitly retained 90B.
The recovered original feed retains route 90B.

name: Newcastle–Oshawa express
description: Express feeder from Newcastle and Bowmanville to Oshawa GO, complementing the slower route 90 local bus. It was replaced by route 88A in the 2020 restructuring.

timeline.event: The original timetable distinguishes Newcastle–Bowmanville–Oshawa express 91 from local route 90.
The original GTFS still contains route 91 and its Newcastle pattern.
Last day of route 91. The replacement weekday 88A began with the September schedule changes.

name: Oshawa–Yorkdale
description: Limited-stop Highway 2 service linking Durham communities with Scarborough Centre and North York. The eastern terminal and the meaning of the 92A suffix have both changed.

timeline.event: Route 92 was introduced in the Highway 2 reorganization replacing the old 94/95 network.
New 92A Ajax–Finch service replaced route 98.
The original timetable shows downtown Oshawa–Yorkdale service; by this edition 92A has become a Dundas/Highway 412–Yorkdale short working.
The main route moved its eastern terminal from downtown Oshawa to Oshawa GO.
The original GTFS retains the later 92A Dundas/Highway 412–Yorkdale short working.

historic_patterns.label: Later 92A Dundas/Highway 412–Yorkdale

name: Durham College / UOIT–Scarborough Centre
description: School-oriented express bus between Scarborough Centre and the shared north Oshawa campus of Durham College and UOIT (now Ontario Tech). Some archive filenames incorrectly identify an original route 93 PDF as route 96.

timeline.event: The original timetable explicitly identifies the campus express as route 93.
School service was restored with additional weekday eastbound trips.
The route remained in the original school-year timetable.
The September service-change notice states that route 93 remained suspended.

name: Oshawa Highway 2; reused Pickering–Mississauga
description: Number 94 was reused for a different corridor: the old Oshawa–Yorkdale Highway 2 bus ended in 2013; a new Pickering–Mississauga service began in 2020 and later incorporated Pearson Airport service.

timeline.event: The original route 94 timetable is Oshawa Highway 2, serving Oshawa GO, downtown Oshawa, Whitby, Ajax, Pickering, Scarborough, York Mills and Yorkdale.
Final day of the old Highway 2 route 94 before the Durham service restructuring.
First weekday service of the new route 94 Pickering–Square One, introduced in the September schedule changes.
The pre-airport timetable shows Pickering–Scarborough–Yorkdale–Keele/401–Square One.
Routes 34 and 94 were combined; the revised 94 includes Pearson Terminal 1 and Transitway stops.

name: Oshawa Highway 2 Express–Finch
description: Limited-stop bus through Durham on Highway 2, continuing by Highway 401 to Scarborough Centre and Finch. It complemented the older local 94 and the station-based Highway 401 express 96.

timeline.event: Routes 95 and 96 were introduced as the Oshawa–Finch express network.
The original route 95 schedule documents the Highway 2 stopping pattern and Finch destination.
Last day of route 95 before the 92/96/98 reorganization.

historic_patterns.label: Oshawa–Finch Highway 2 limited-stop service
historic_patterns.notes: Westbound timing points. In the opposite direction the Whitby stop is labelled White Oaks rather than McQuay. The bus uses Highway 2 through Durham, then the Highway 401 corridor toward Toronto.

name: Oshawa–Finch Express
description: Highway 401 bus family linking Durham GO stations with North York. Multiple express and short branches were later consolidated as 96B; seasonal 96Z added the Toronto Zoo.

timeline.event: Routes 95 and 96 began as complementary Oshawa–Finch express services.
The original timetable documents 96 and branches A–D, with 96B serving Scarborough Centre between the Durham stations and Finch.
The original timetable contains the 96, 96A, 96B, 96C, 96D and 96E family.
Service was consolidated on 96B; branches 96, 96A, 96C, 96D and 96E were withdrawn.
Seasonal 96Z Toronto Zoo trips began alongside 96B.

timeline.event: The new route 98 appears in the June 29 timetable; its weekday-only service first operated Tuesday July 2 after the holiday weekend.
